c1.hasil_ringkas: Buah apel dihitung pada video dengan YOLO dan DeepSORT yang disesuaikan (fitur ResNet); abstrak hanya menyatakan akurasi pencacahan tinggi tanpa angka.

bukti: We perform fruit counting on video footage by following a two-stage pipeline that consists of detecting the fruits, then tracking them frame-by-frame.
New detections are associated with old detections by comparing their features as a distance metric, where two objects with minimal distance are associated together.
catatan: DeepSORT dikodekan M2+M3 sesuai konvensi; abstrak hanya menguraikan asosiasi berbasis jarak fitur tampilan, sehingga penghapus duplikat ditulis M2. Abstrak tidak menyebut acuan hitung maupun angka hasil.

bukti: This study evaluated the effect of image input representation on convolutional neural network (CNN)-based FFB ripeness classification.
RGB and IR images were acquired using a dual-camera setup positioned 3 m from the FFB sample.
the experimental setup evaluated single static FFB against relatively con-trolled background conditions under natural afternoon sunlight.

bukti: This study assesses the efficacy of utilizing multiple cameras at varying elevations and azimuthal angles to enhance fruit visibility.
a single camera whose optical axis was perpendicular to the canopy could detect up to 88.3% of the fruits detected by four cameras.
catatan: Abstrak tidak menyebut cara menyatukan deteksi buah yang sama antarkamera; M4 adalah dugaan dari susunan kamera berposisi tetap dan perlu diperiksa pada teks lengkap. Acuan pembanding adalah jumlah buah unik hasil gabungan empat kamera, bukan hitungan lapangan. Tujuan utama adalah visibilitas untuk robot panen, bukan estimasi hasil.

bukti: The mapping process identifies the individual fruitlet at each scan point and then registers them into a 3D map as the arm scans the branch.
Each fruitlet is assigned a count id (Fig. 3f) and would merge with the fruitlet generated in the next iteration to avoid duplication.
Each fruitlet growing on a branch was manually counted, and the diameter of the fruitlet was measured at the widest point using a vernier caliper.

bukti: The results indicate that the system can classify oil palm fruit into four distinct categories: Over-Ripe, Ripe, Half-Ripe, and Raw.
An accuracy rate of 85% was achieved.

bukti: This study investigates the potential of the YOLOv8 framework, particularly its YOLOv8m variant, for ripeness classification and detection.
This model's mAP50-95 of 0.927 balances computational efficiency and accuracy
